description: Read the local administrator password from ms-Mcs-AdmPwd (LAPS) on a computer object.

telemetry.detail: Directory Service Access reading the LAPS attribute - requires object SACL auditing on the computer (default OFF).
ITDR (MDI) and some EDRs flag anomalous LAPS reads, especially at volume.

prerequisite_privilege: ReadLAPSPassword / All-Extended-Rights on the computer object
abuse_primitive: Read ms-Mcs-AdmPwd, then use the local admin password to move to the host.
notes: A read, so it is quiet by default. Loud only where LAPS-attribute auditing (4662) or MDI LAPS modelling is present.
